svg.title: Every policy across the 8 environment categories
svg.desc: Mean normalized reward per step over the final 100,928 steps of the 1,000,000-step best recording, one axis per declared category with its environment count, the better of Random and the constant do-nothing policy at 0 and Oracle at 1. Above the floor the radius is linear; below it the radius follows minus log(1 minus the score), so every policy stays on the chart unclipped. Outlines only: the polygon area is not the score. The overall ranking is the equal-weight mean over all 245 environments.

g.text: Mean normalized reward per step · 245 environments · best recording 6e891e535
Equal weight per environment · outlines, not areas · floor = max(Random, Constant) = 0 · Oracle = 1 · final 100,928 of 1,000,000 steps
Above the floor the radius is linear; below it the radius is log-compressed, so every policy is drawn unclipped.
